name: Receipt Maker
short: A clean payment receipt PDF: who paid, for what, how. Done in a minute.

seo.metaTitle: Free Receipt Maker: Payment Receipt PDF
seo.metaDescription: Make a professional payment receipt PDF with payment method, date and line items. For cash, transfers and deposits. No signup, nothing uploaded.

intro: Money changed hands; now somebody needs it on paper. The tenant paying cash wants proof, the client who paid a deposit wants it acknowledged, the buyer of your old camera wants something for their records, and bookkeeping on both sides wants a document with a date, an amount and a method. A receipt is the smallest business document there is, and this tool produces a proper one in about a minute.

It runs on the same engine as our invoice and quote tools, so your details and logo are already in place, and the receipt-specific fields are exactly two: the payment date and the payment method, cash, transfer, card, whichever. The notes line handles the balance-remaining case that deposits create, which is the sentence most improvised receipts forget and most disputes later hinge on.
howto: Your business or personal details load from the shared saved block; adjust if needed.
Enter who paid, the receipt number, the date and the payment method.
Describe what was paid for as line items; one line is often enough.
Add tax only if the receipt needs to show it; otherwise leave it at zero.
Use the notes line for what remains owing, if anything: 'balance of 500 due on delivery'.
Download the PDF, send one copy, keep one.
benefits: Cash is the reason this tool exists: transfers and cards document themselves, cash documents nothing, and the receipt is the only record either side will ever have. Rent paid in cash, market sales, second-hand deals, deposits in trades where cash is customary: all of them need the date-amount-method triangle on paper with both parties named, and improvising it in a text message is how 'I already paid you' arguments are born. A numbered PDF with your details printed settles the matter before it becomes one.

The balance-remaining note is the professional touch that costs nothing here: a deposit receipt that states what remains and when converts a vague arrangement into a schedule, and the client who signed off on that receipt has agreed to the schedule without a single awkward conversation. The engine's privacy carries over as always, which for receipts means your cash flow is not a template site's analytics. The [invoice generator](/tools/invoice-generator/) requests the money this document confirms, and the [credit note generator](/tools/credit-note-generator/) handles the day some of it goes back.

The numbering habit turns receipts from favours into records: a sequential series with dates is a cash ledger assembled one document at a time, and at tax season the difference between a shoebox of memories and a folder of numbered PDFs is measured in accountant hours you pay for. The tool numbers by default because the habit should not depend on remembering to have it.
useCases: Landlords issuing rent receipts, legally required in some places and simply wise everywhere cash is involved, produce a numbered monthly trail in minutes. Freelancers acknowledge deposits with balance terms attached, quietly locking the payment schedule. Sellers of second-hand goods give buyers the proof of purchase that makes both sides comfortable in person-to-person deals.

Small services, tutors, cleaners and repair trades hand clients something bookkeepers accept at tax time. And anyone reimbursed in cash by an employer or a friend for a group purchase closes the loop with a document instead of a memory.

faqs.q: Is a receipt from this tool valid?
faqs.a: A receipt's validity comes from what it records: who paid whom, how much, when, by what method, for what. This produces exactly that as a clean numbered PDF. For tax-regulated retail receipts, some countries require registered systems; for ordinary proof of payment between parties, this is the standard form.

faqs.q: What is the difference between an invoice and a receipt?
faqs.a: Direction of time: an invoice requests payment that has not happened; a receipt confirms payment that has. A deposit often produces both: an invoice for the total, then a receipt for the deposit with the balance noted.

faqs.q: How do I write a rent receipt?
faqs.a: Landlord details as sender, tenant as payer, the month as the line item, the amount, the date and the method, plus a running receipt number. Issue one per payment and both sides keep a trail; the tool numbers them for you.

faqs.q: Do I add tax on a receipt?
faqs.a: Only if the underlying sale is taxed and the receipt is documenting the tax: then it shows the same split as the invoice. Pure proof-of-payment receipts, rent between individuals for example, usually show only the amount.

faqs.q: Can I make one for a partial payment?
faqs.a: Yes, and the balance note is the point: state the amount received and what remains with its due date. The next payment gets its own numbered receipt, and the trail tells the whole story.

faqs.q: Should I keep copies of receipts I issue?
faqs.a: Always: your copy is your record of income received, and the sequence's integrity depends on keeping every number. A folder per year of the PDFs, named by number, is bookkeeping enough for most small operations.
